name: Mardan
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP point is a population-weighted Mardan locator, not a parcel identity. Official KP Revenue pages confirm Mardan land-record SDCs, computerized records and e-Registry operation. The Directorate describes GIS cadastral mapping at the provincial level, but no Mardan public map viewer or parcel feature service was linked. No registry transaction, applicant detail or property query was submitted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The KP Revenue & Estate Department lists an operational SDC at Mardan main Kachehries and additional centers at Takht Bahi and Katlang; its SDC page describes computerized land records. The department also confirms that provincial e-Registry is operational in Mardan. These confirm city-specific registration/record services, not public parcel geometry.

remainingUncertainty: Whether the Mardan SDC/LRMIS has a public map service separate from its record and registration workflows; exact parcel coverage is unknown.
